Nestled at the southern gateway of Hanoi, Yen So Park stands as a sprawling oasis of tranquility within the bustling urban landscape. This expansive green space, often affectionately referred to as the "green lung" of the capital, spans across a vast expanse of land that was once a crucial regulating lake and wetland area of Hanoi.

The park's centerpiece is a large central regulating lake, surrounded by lush green lawns and winding paths that meander through the verdant landscape. These paths, lined with rows of trees, reflect the beauty of nature onto the calm waters, creating a picturesque scene that is both calming and invigorating.
